hypothesis: Disagreement among already computed rotated and reflected views ranks unreliable uploads better than the mean distribution's top score.
primary_signal: Negative Jensen-Shannon disagreement across eight D4 views
secondary_signal: Fraction of eight views whose top label agrees with the averaged top label
evaluation: Macro-average supported-vs-unsupported AUROC across supported sources for each unsupported group. Compare pooled and source-level AUROC for predicting correctness. Report pair counts and no source-level correctness AUROC when a class is missing. Preserve the deployed labels and scores.
decision: No fitting, calibration, threshold change, training or promotion. Advance only if the primary disagreement score meets all listed guards. Independent confirmation is mandatory before any app policy change.
reference: Shanmugam et al., Better Aggregation in Test-Time Augmentation, ICCV 2021, https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2021/html/Shanmugam_Better_Aggregation_in_Test-Time_Augmentation_ICCV_2021_paper.html
